info.title: jevplay - a local playground for Jev (System One) models.
info.description: A local playground for Jev (System One) models: a context, typed questions, answers with their probabilities.

options.name: --model
options.description: Model to send. Defaults to the provider's own.

options.name: --port
options.description: Port to listen on. Defaults to a free port picked by the OS.

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show the version.
Providers:
typesafe     Official TypeSafe API, https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone
Model jev-latest. Key required.
Body shape unverified: see the README.
simple-jev   Public Simple Jev demo, https://simple-jev-demo-api.featherless.ai/v1/classifier
Model featherless-ai/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-classifier.
No key. Limits: 2k context tokens, 2 requests/s.
mock         Deterministic simulated answers, no network call.
